source_evidence: Exact player 'Ask the civilians' authorizes approaching the sheltered civilians and asking what happened, not pursuit, accepting payment/contract, sharing classified papers, spending or forcing testimony. D356~10:16–10:26 V/Cirren/Fenar approach the western refuge safely after four armed men withdraw, Mara voluntarily remains with the screened coach/four horses nearby. Waystation proprietor willingly greets party with relief and provides first-hand testimony consistent with fixed independent clue from prep/dm-only/dm-hollow-pennant.md @ba86b23cb89d85846bb0ae8652d31cf47fd2e4d6: on D353 (newly established actual witness recollection, not previously dated play), the same recognizable officer came to the station wearing Ossent colors, claimed to be requisitioning provisions, and demanded supplies. Today D356 the proprietor personally recognizes that same face/voice despite Crownsunder colors and renewed demands for stores. This is attributable witness evidence of deliberate contradictory claimed identity, independent of D306 frontier report and V's own current observation; no proof of exact company name, sponsor, genuine orders, next attack date, or universal national involvement. Proprietor confirms today's demanded supplies remained at station when four withdrew. He does not know their ultimate employer, route after eastward departure or depot's exact location; V has officer's prior spoken toll-fort lead, not verified directions. All eight noncombatants accounted for by ordinary observation and conversation, two existing injured travelers require assistance walking, no additional wounds from current requisition or invented attribution of old injuries to named soldiers. Cirren checks they are conscious and presently stable, offers ordinary assistance; no mechanical HP restored, spell or kit expense, no invented civilian stat blocks. Fenar watches east trail; after ten minutes soldiers disappear beyond bend, exact subsequent movement/arrival unobserved; no pursuit or signal assumed. Proprietor willing to explain account privately to competent investigators if safety protected, no signed deposition, contract, reward, new acceptance or guaranteed anonymity. No uncertainty roll required for willing eyewitness account and visible welfare check. V chooses next action, including questions, examination of station, or following eastern trail; no seized enemy material, no new independent clue of packing chit/reversed livery (remain with departing detail), no Crown milestone automatically earned or paid. V/C/F at western refuge near(-30,0) relative east door, Mara with coach at wooded rise~120ft west. All actual party resources/custody/purse unchanged, other state preserved.
